summary: At the prepared main base, transformers 5.12.1 exposes PreTrainedConfig and PretrainedConfig as the same class, import sglang and all five named modules succeed, and the source already uses exist_ok=True for both qwen3_asr AutoConfig registrations. The same focused boundaries pass with an isolated transformers 5.16.1 dependency overlay, so no source correction was justified.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reported defect is entirely in Python import and Transformers AutoConfig registration paths; no GPU kernel, model execution, or numerical output is involved. No unrelated GPU smoke was used as evidence.
